features.name: nsw_vic_price_distance
features.description: Absolute difference between NSW and VIC electricity prices, acting as a 1D distance metric.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN group periods with similar inter-regional price spreads.

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_distance
features.description: Absolute difference between NSW and VIC electricity demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by clustering rows with similar demand imbalances.

features.name: total_demand_magnitude
features.description: Euclidean norm of the demand in both regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a unified magnitude of demand, allowing KNN to easily find neighbors with similar overall load.

features.name: price_demand_euclidean_norm
features.description: Euclidean norm of all price and demand variables.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a composite distance-from-origin metric in the 4D price-demand space.

features.name: transfer_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Absolute deviation of the transfer amount from its training set mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights anomalous transfer volumes, helping KNN isolate typical vs atypical transfer states.

features.name: distance_to_mean_demand
features.description: Euclidean distance to the unsupervised prototype representing average demand in both regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centers the demand space around the global mean, improving distance calculations for KNN.

features.name: distance_to_mean_price
features.description: Euclidean distance to the unsupervised prototype representing average price in both regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centers the price space around the global mean, aiding in identifying price-shock neighborhoods.

features.name: transfer_to_mean_demand_distance
features.description: Absolute difference between the transfer value and the average demand of the two regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relationship between inter-regional transfer and overall demand levels.

features.name: high_demand_cluster_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for periods where both regions experience above-average demand (>0.5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct subspace for high-demand events, forcing KNN to group these critical periods together.

features.name: max_price_deviation
features.description: The maximum absolute deviation of either region's price from its respective mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Uses Chebyshev-like distance to identify extreme price events in either market.

features.name: demand_imbalance_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of the severity of demand imbalance between NSW and VIC regions, considering historical transfer capacity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous semantic score that helps KNN weigh the importance of demand mismatches beyond simple subtraction.

features.name: market_stress_indicator
features.description: Semantic evaluation of overall market stress based on combined high prices, high demand, and extreme transfer values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a soft cluster assignment, grouping periods of high market stress closer together in the feature space.
